title: Epic Core API - Community Port (1.21.1+)
summary: Unofficial NeoForge port of Epic Core API by CJiangqiu to newer Minecraft, maintained by the community with the author's permission.

sources.label: Epic Core API by CJiangqiu
sources.note: An unofficial port of the original to NeoForge 1.21.1, with the original's content.

disclosures.note: The changes that port the original to NeoForge 1.21.1, and this page's text, were made with an AI coding assistant and checked by automated gates and a person playing it. The mod's content, art and design are the original author's.
Includes an optional shader-generator tool that can call an AI service you configure with your own URL and API key. Nothing is sent unless you set it up.

interactions: Writes its Java agent jar to the system temporary folder when it loads it, and deletes it on exit.
disclosures.note: Modrinth build only; the CurseForge build does not include the agent.
